decisions: Food-truck word: recommend Cyrillic “фүүд трак” (as Mongolian writes фүүд корт, кофе шоп), uninflected before a noun (“фүүд трак бизнест”, “фүүд трак эрхлэгчид”) so no case ending lands on the loanword; Latin “food truck” as a secondary keyword. No indexed Mongolian page uses it — native / Keyword Planner check needed (Low).
Script: Mongolian CYRILLIC only, with ө and ү (never о/у substitutes, never the Latin transliteration seen in chats).
Pay at Hatch: “Очиж авахдаа төлөх” (feature) / “Газар дээр нь төлөх” (short). Never “хүргэлтээр төлөх”, “хүргэгчид бэлнээр төлөх” or “хүлээн авахдаа төлөх” (delivery / COD wording).
Menu: “цэс” in UI (standard Mongolian), “меню” is common in press (ikon.mn) — keep it as an SEO secondary term.

Messaging: Facebook Messenger is the everyday messenger in Mongolia (general knowledge, not verified in this research) — the WhatsApp auto-reply feature may matter less on MN pages; Dominic may want to de-emphasise it there.
Order button: no Mongolian statutory button wording was found (the consumer-protection law text was not fetched); market norm “Захиалах” / “Захиалга баталгаажуулах”.
